title: Wetlands Vanish Faster Than Forests After 35% Loss
hook: Wetlands lost 35% while forests declined far less.
closing: Losing wetlands removes natural protection for clean water and flood control.
question: Is a wetland near you?

segments.say: Global wetland extent fell 35%. Nature's water filters are disappearing within a single human lifetime.
Forests lost 12% over the same span. Wetlands vanished nearly three times faster.
Europe lost 50% of its wetlands. No other listed region comes close to that decline.
